name: meridian-monorepo
description: Meridian: 100% Offline, Pure-TypeScript Distributed Virtual Power Plant (VPP) & Real-Time Energy Trading Monorepo

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/domain-core packages/crypto-auth packages/event-bus packages/ts-storage packages/distributed-lock packages/ledger-engine apps/edge-fleet-simulator apps/telemetry-ingestor apps/anomaly-detector apps/grid-orchestrator apps/market-bidding-engine apps/settlement-service apps/control-plane-api
scripts.clean: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); for (const p of ['packages','apps']) { for (const d of fs.readdirSync(p)) fs.rmSync(p+'/'+d+'/dist',{recursive:true,force:true}); }"
